title: Tracing Stereotypes from Representation to Output in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple-choice stereotype association tests (MBBQ) and downstream evaluation benchmarks (SHADES) combined with mechanistic interpretability methods including layer-wise linear probing, attribution patching, and SAE feature ablation.
